name: rescue3d-disaster-response-simulator
description: Rescue3D: A 3D Interactive Disaster Management and Emergency Response Simulator

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace apps/api

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
